spec.source:
sequenceDiagram
 participant U as User
 participant A as Personal Agent
 participant C as Company
 A->>C: Request device authorization
 C-->>A: Link, user code and private device code
 A-->>U: Show company, link and user code
 U->>C: Sign in and approve on another device
 A->>C: Poll with device code and key proof
 C-->>A: Account and Session Tokens
